text:
Ava: Quick design pass on Compliance > Data & Keys page. Couple of tiny but important nits re: KMS/encryption labels, retention dropdown ordering, and audit log link copy. Screenshot + notes: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxxx :eyes:
Sam: Saw that — thanks. Two questions: do we want the KMS badge to say 'Customer-managed keys (KMS)' or 'Customer-managed key'? Also the blue 'Encrypted' pill is a little ambiguous for users who don't know what it's for.
Miguel: For copy I'd prefer 'Encryption: Managed by customer (KMS)'. Short, signals ownership. Also maybe move KMS info into tooltip not primary label.
Priya: Accessibility nit — the badge is not announced by screen readers. Can we add aria-label='Encryption: managed by customer via KMS' and role='status' on the badge? Also ensure the tooltip is keyboard-focusable.
Jess: On retention dropdown — current order is '30 days, 90 days, 7 days, custom' which confuses support. Recommend sorting ascending or putting the org default (90 days) at the top with '(recommended)'.
Ava: Product preference is default = 90 days. I like the '(recommended)' hint. Also the retention control needs clearer helper copy: current 'Retention period' is vague — how about 'Default data retention for logs and artifacts'.
Sam: I'll paste a suggested microcopy block for review:
```
Encryption: Customer-managed (KMS)
Default data retention: 90 days (recommended)
Audit logs: View audit trail for this resource
```
Miguel: Slight tweak on the last line — 'View audit trail for this key' is more explicit if we're on the key detail page.
design-bot: Figma file updated (frame: Data & Keys > Key detail) — adjusted badge padding, added tooltip copy, moved retention default to top. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxxx (auto-update)
Priya: Also add visible focus outline on the retention dropdown and make sure the tooltip can be opened with keyboard only (aria-haspopup + tabindex=0). Screen reader should read the tooltip text when focused.
Jess: Ops question — should the 'Customer-managed (KMS)' label link to a KB article about key ownership and rotation? Customers often ask where to manage keys.
Ava: Yes add a small 'Learn more' link next to the KMS label that opens docs about key ownership and rotation. Make link target _blank and include rel=noopener.
Sam: One more copy nit: in audit log export flow the CTA currently says 'Download logs' — recommend 'Export audit trail (CSV)' so it's explicit about format.
Miguel: Agree. Also caps: use sentence case for labels (not Title Case) to match Console conventions.
Priya: Quick manual test I ran: NVDA reads the badge as "Button" currently — it's not a button. Please ensure it's a span with role='status' and not focusable unless it opens a tooltip.
Ava: Action items: Sam update mocks + microcopy + add learn-more link; Priya run a11y checklist and share results; Miguel confirm text for different resource contexts; Jess add docs link and update export CTA copy; I'll open a PR for the console components once mocks land. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
